goal: Extract CSS identifier and escaping responsibilities (escape/unescape and related helpers) from TokenQueue into a new class org.jsoup.parser.CssIdentifier to reduce TokenQueue's public and total method counts and concentrate related logic.

expected_impact.rationale: This extraction moves the two public static methods escapeCssIdentifier and unescape plus seven private/static helper methods that solely support CSS identifier serialization/parsing. That reduces TokenQueue's public method count by 2 and its total method count by ~9, and groups all CSS identifier/escaping responsibilities into a single coherent class.

ops.details: Create new package-visible class org.jsoup.parser.CssIdentifier containing the two public static methods (escapeCssIdentifier, unescape) and the private/static helper methods that they need. The new class will live in the same package and will reuse org.jsoup.internal.StringUtil and org.jsoup.helper.Validate imports. Helper constants required by escaping (such as ESC, Hyphen_Minus, Unicode_Null, Replacement) will be declared privately inside the new class to keep the extraction self-contained and avoid coupling TokenQueue internals. The extraction groups the CSS identifier serialization and escaping concern into a single coherent class.
Move escapeCssIdentifier implementation into CssIdentifier. The implementation will be identical but will reference the helper methods moved into CssIdentifier instead of TokenQueue.
Move unescape implementation into CssIdentifier unchanged except for any private-helper references that are also moved.
